title: Declarations
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.93 Numbered Discourses 5.93
  • 10. Kakudhavagga 10. With Kakudha

Byākaraṇasutta Declarations

“Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, aññābyākaraṇāni. “Mendicants, there are five ways of declaring enlightenment. Katamāni pañca? What five? Mandattā momūhattā aññaṁ byākaroti; One declares enlightenment out of stupidity and folly. pāpiccho icchāpakato aññaṁ byākaroti; Or because of corrupt wishes, being of wishful temperament. ummādā cittakkhepā aññaṁ byākaroti; Or because of madness and mental disorder. adhimānena aññaṁ byākaroti; Or out of overestimation. sammadeva aññaṁ byākaroti. Or one declares enlightenment rightly. Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca aññābyākaraṇānī”ti. These are the five ways of declaring enlightenment.”

Tatiyaṁ.
